releaseNotes: v2.0.2: Comprehensive UI + root-cause fix pass
Fixed blank Hotkeys/Updates settings tabs (missing SecondaryButton style)
Fixed slider track visibility (only thumb was rendering)
Simplified hotkeys to F2 (Celebration) + F8 (Audio Toggle)
Debounced settings saves to fix slider drag latency
Settings scroll resets to top on category switch
Supabase uploads use configurable upload token (service role key)
Fixed NADD price chart rendering (chart was 0-width in Auto column)
Fixed BarChartView label positioning (TextAlignment on Canvas TextBlocks doesn't work)
Live CS2 status updates via StateChanged event
